import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import type { Note } from "{{scope}}/notebook/domain";
import { CreateNoteCommand } from "./create-note.command.ts";
import type { CreateNoteStore } from "./create-note.contract.ts";
import { CreateNoteHandler } from "./create-note.handler.ts";

class FakeCreateNoteStore implements CreateNoteStore {
  readonly saved: Note[] = [];

  async save(note: Note): Promise<void> {
    this.saved.push(note);
  }
}

function command(text: string): CreateNoteCommand {
  const parsed = CreateNoteCommand.parse({ text });
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.error);
  return parsed.value;
}

describe("CreateNoteHandler", () => {
  test("creates the note and saves it", async () => {
    const store = new FakeCreateNoteStore();
    const note = await new CreateNoteHandler(store).execute(command("Buy milk"));
    expect(note.text.value).toBe("Buy milk");
    expect(store.saved).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(store.saved[0]?.equals(note)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("gives every note a new identity", async () => {
    const handler = new CreateNoteHandler(new FakeCreateNoteStore());
    const first = await handler.execute(command("Same"));
    const second = await handler.execute(command("Same"));
    expect(first.equals(second)).toBe(false);
  });
});
